_meta.description: Wallets controlled by gambling platforms (casino/betting hot wallets and the per-user deposit addresses that sweep into them). A match is an attribution, like an exchange: the platform holds the account and can identify its holder on a lawful request.
_meta.provenance: Hot wallets: block explorer gambling tags via dawsbot/eth-labels. Deposit addresses: on-chain sweeps (>=2) of USDT/USDC into those hot wallets. Built by backend/scripts/import_gambling_labels.py.
_meta.verification_note: Each deposit row cites a sample sweep transaction. Not a designation and not a finding of wrongdoing by anyone.
_meta.schema: labels maps an address to {category, entity, label, source}
